answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, revoked by a single upheld challenge, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the walnut of a task receipt, and the reef is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The nectar of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
